trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of thm:strong-multiplicativity, judged on all ten categories; the superlative was the only trap and is recorded as a separate fail entry with the fix applied.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: NOT A TRAP, reported separately: the .md's opening claim - 'the Frobenius relation is preserved under the Groebner-Shirshov deformation at every filtration degree' - is precisely the framing the resolved Lean (Fred2005.strong_multiplicativity_holds) says was removed as misleading; its docstring records that the theorem is now only an accessor for G's own comul_hom axiom, that the gsb hypotheses were dropped as unused, and that 'at every filtration degree' needs a filtered-deformation structure the model does not carry. The .md also lists def:grobner-shirshov-basis in uses[] though the Lean statement no longer mentions it.
